import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

text = input('Moment (YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM:SS): ')
moment = datetime.strptime(text, '%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')
today = datetime(2026, 10, 1, 12, 0, 0)  # a fixed 'now', so every run gives the same lines
wait = moment - today
print('Weekday:', moment.strftime('%A'))
print('Wait:', wait, '=', wait.total_seconds(), 'seconds')
print('1000 days later:', (moment + timedelta(days=1000)).strftime('%B %d, %Y'))

day = moment.date()
found = []
while len(found) < 3:
    day += timedelta(days=1)
    if day.day == 13 and day.weekday() == 4:
        found.append(day.strftime('%B %Y'))
print('Next Friday the 13ths:', ', '.join(found))

# a stopwatch on made-up clock readings, so nothing sleeps
marks = [3.56, 8.63, 17.68, 19.11]
last = 0.0
for n, total in enumerate(marks, 1):
    lap = round(total - last, 2)
    last = total
    print('Lap #' + str(n).rjust(2) + ': ' + str(total).rjust(6) + ' (' + str(lap).rjust(6) + ')')
print(time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d', time.gmtime(0)))
